notes.label: shape the next EMG iteration
notes.copy: Develop the software around the existing signal, refine data processing, and sketch a clearer interface for reviewing a session.
notes.detail: Move from a working measurement toward a usable experience.

notes.label: edit, verify, and simplify
notes.copy: Review each scene for clear, distinct, public-safe storytelling. Confirm facts and keep only details that help visitors understand the work.
notes.detail: Every claim stays concise and supportable.

notes.label: make Lab 17 the one official site
notes.copy: Retire outdated naming, consolidate the durable documentation, and prepare one clean source of truth for the portfolio.

notes.label: refine the room and its interactions
notes.copy: Polish models, framing, lighting, and object behavior across desktop and mobile so exploration feels intentional and clear.
notes.detail: Keep the atmosphere; remove the friction.

notes.label: preview, listen, then release
notes.copy: Run final content, accessibility, interaction, and performance checks. Share a controlled preview, gather feedback, and publish only when the room is ready.
notes.detail: Release readiness is a checkpoint, not a date.
